import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/t'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,stream,crypto,datagram,trace
from diff import cmp
K=[{'keys':['A']}]
cases=[
 # MAX_STREAM_DATA / STOP on server uni stream index 0 (localUni=2)
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,bytes([0x11])+v(3)+v(9)).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'msd server uni'),
 # MAX_STREAM_DATA on server uni index 2 (localUni=2) -> STREAM_STATE_ERROR
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,bytes([0x11])+v(11)+v(9)).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'msd server uni oob'),
 # STREAM on server bidi index 1 (localBidi=2)
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,stream(5,0,b'ab')).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'stream server bidi'),
 # STREAM on server bidi index 2 -> STREAM_STATE_ERROR
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,stream(9,0,b'ab')).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'stream server bidi oob'),
 # client uni stream 2 with STOP -> STREAM_STATE_ERROR
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,bytes([0x05])+v(2)+v(0)).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'stop client uni'),
 # zero-length FIN at 0
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,bytes([0x09])+v(0)).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'fin len0'),
 # reset then stream with fin
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,bytes([0x04])+v(0)+v(1)+v(9)).hex(),'auth':[0]}},
     {'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',1,bytes([0x0d])+v(0)+v(0)+v(0)).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'reset then fin'),
 # stream data at 2^62-1 offset (overflow)
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,stream(0,2**62-1,b'z')).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'overflow offset'),
 # crypto overflow
 ([{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('I',0,bytes([0x06])+v(2**62-1)+v(1)+b'z').hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'crypto overflow'),
 # new_connection_id with retire_prior_to below existing threshold (no change)
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,bytes([0x18])+v(5)+v(5)+bytes([1])+b'\xf0'+bytes(16)).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'ncid seq5 rpt5'),
 # retire the same cid in the same packet twice, plus a stream
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,bytes([0x19])+v(1)+stream(0,0,b'q')).hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'retire+stream'),
 # datagram frame lengthless at A
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,bytes([0x30])+b'rest').hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'datagram lenless'),
 # padding only
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,b'\x00\x00\x00').hex(),'auth':[0]}}],{},'padding only'),
 # multi envelope: I,H,A with token
 ([{'keys':['I','H','A']},{'datagram':{'wire':(envelope('I',0,crypto(0,b'a'),token=b'tok')+envelope('H',0,crypto(0,b'b'))+envelope('A',0,b'\x01',cid=b'\xaa')).hex(),'auth':[0,0,0]}}],{},'I H A'),
 # no auth entries at all
 (K+[{'datagram':{'wire':envelope('A',0,b'\x01').hex(),'auth':[]}}],{},'no auth'),
]
ok=bad=0
for evs,kw,label in cases:
    tr=trace(evs,**kw)
    if cmp({'traces':[tr]},label): ok+=1
    else: bad+=1
print('ok',ok,'bad',bad)
PYEOF
